remarks: Welcome to this beautifully remodeled first-floor residence in a well-maintained two-family home, offering 4 spacious bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms. This bright and inviting unit has been completely updated throughout, featuring a brand-new modern kitchen, beautifully renovated bathrooms, new flooring, and fresh contemporary finishes. Electricity is included in the rent, providing added value and convenience. Ideally located within walking distance to Norwalk Hospital and convenient to shopping, dining, local beaches, major highways, Metro-North transportation, and easy access toward New York City. A spacious, move-in-ready home combining modern comfort with an excellent Norwalk location. Schedule your private showing today!
